candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (Uradni list RS) — enarocanje.si
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national publication point under ZJN-3 for all Slovenian procurement notices, including 'obvestilo o oddaji naročila' (contract award notices) from banks, SID banka, Banka Slovenije, ministries, FURS and UJP. Award notices carry named winners, contract values and dates — the most quantitative signal in the cell. Banka Slovenije explicitly states all its procurement documentation is published here.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for reading notices
candidates.legal_status: official public register (ZJN-3); republication of public-sector information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scripted search of the notice form pages (form/notice id URLs of the shape https://www.enarocanje.si/Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN) filtered by CPV codes for financial/banking/IT services; store notice metadata + PDF/HTML docs. Respect Splošni pogoji (general terms PDF at /Splosni_pogoji_PJN_ver6_20240119.pdf) and throttle.
queries_used: portal javnih naročil enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila bančne storitve
Banka Slovenije javna naročila objave bsi.si

candidates.source_name: e-JN — Informacijski sistem za elektronsko javno naročanje (ejn.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: The state e-procurement transaction system where tenders are actually run and bids submitted; publishes 'Aktualna javna naročila' (live tenders) and hosts the DJN guidance pages. Gives forward-looking pipeline (what public financial bodies are about to buy) ahead of award notices.
candidates.access_status: public listing pages; bidding requires registration/e-identity
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public 'aktualna javna naročila' listing page and, preferably, the mirrored OPSI open dataset of active e-JN tenders rather than scraping the JSF pages.
queries_used: Uprava RS za javna plačila UJP javna naročila razpisi ujp.gov.si
portal javnih naročil enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v informacijskem sistemu e-JN (open dataset)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable open-data mirror of live e-JN tenders (contracting authority, tender name and code, publication number and date, submission deadline, bid opening, status) since April 2018 — the cleanest structured ingest path for the procurement route, avoiding portal scraping.
candidates.legal_status: open data licence (Slovenian open data portal terms)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CKAN API against podatki.gov.si (package_show / resource download) on a daily schedule; join to enarocanje notice ids.
queries_used: statistika javnih naročil ministrstvo za javno upravo odprti podatki podatki.gov.si javna naročila

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU notices, Slovenia filter)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level publication of all above-threshold Slovenian notices, including contract award notices for banking, payment and IT services. Bilingual (sl/en) structured notices with CPV codes, values and awarded economic operators; the most automatable cross-border comparison layer and a way to catch notices whose Slovenian text is thin.
candidates.access_status: public, free; search UI plus documented Search API and bulk packages
candidates.legal_status: EU official journal supplement; reuse permitted under EU reuse policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API with filters country=SI and CPV families 66100000 (banking/financial), 66500000, 72000000 (IT services), 30144200/30162000 (payment/terminal equipment); notice-type = contract award. Fall back to bulk XML packages for backfill.
queries_used: TED tenders electronic daily Slovenia contract award notice banking payment services

candidates.source_name: OpenTender / Open Contracting Data Registry — TED-derived EU procurement data
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party cleaned and normalised TED data in OCDS form, useful for historical backfill, buyer/supplier entity resolution and value time-series for Slovenian public financial bodies without re-parsing raw TED XML.
candidates.legal_status: open data; derived work — verify against TED before quoting figures
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk OCDS download, filter buyer country SI; use only as a secondary/derived layer with TED as ground truth.
queries_used: TED tenders electronic daily Slovenia contract award notice banking payment services

candidates.source_name: SID banka — Letna poročila (annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned promotional/export bank; annual reports back to 2006 give balance sheet, lending programmes, IT and operating cost lines, and strategy for a bank that is itself a contracting authority under ZJN-3. Directly on-topic for the run's 'annual reports' and 'disclosures' topics.
candidates.legal_status: issuer disclosure / public information (ZDIJZ obliged body)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of /letna-porocila and /o-banki/investitorji for new PDF links; archive PDFs with hash and publication date.
queries_used: SID banka letno poročilo sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: SID banka — Novice / sporočila za javnost
candidates.why_relevant: Press release stream announcing new financing programmes, funding lines, partnerships with commercial banks and results — an early-warning feed that usually precedes the annual report by months.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the news index page (check for RSS first); diff item lists, fetch article bodies.
queries_used: SID banka letno poročilo sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: SID banka — Informacije javnega značaja / katalog
candidates.why_relevant: ZDIJZ catalogue page — points to the bank's obligatory disclosures, contract/business transparency registers and the FOI request route. Pointer to documents not otherwise indexed, and the legal basis for requesting procurement detail.
candidates.legal_status: ZDIJZ (Access to Public Information Act) obligation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual review quarterly; use as a map of what can be requested under ZDIJZ.
queries_used: SID banka letno poročilo sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: SDH — Slovenski državni holding, dokumentno središče in letna poročila upravljanja
candidates.why_relevant: Manages the state's capital investments (11.2 bn EUR book value at end-2022) including stakes in banks and insurers. The 'Letno poročilo o upravljanju kapitalskih naložb RS in SDH' reports to the National Assembly and names each holding with valuation, dividends and performance targets — a direct read on state ownership in banking and on divestment intentions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl dokumentno-sredisce and kljucni-dokumenti-upravljanja for new PDFs; also track the annual 'Letni načrt upravljanja' for forward-looking ownership plans.
queries_used: SDH Slovenski državni holding letno poročilo upravljanje kapitalskih naložb banke

candidates.source_name: UJP JN Plačila — poročanje o plačilih iz javnega naročanja
candidates.why_relevant: Since 1 Jan 2023 every contracting authority must report monthly the payments actually executed under public procurement contracts, and publish the contracts, through this UJP portal. This converts award notices into realised spend — the strongest available evidence of what vendors are actually being paid by public financial bodies.
candidates.access_status: public search interface expected; reporting side requires authority credentials — public export path unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Test the public search/export endpoints; if no bulk export exists, cross-check the same payments through Erar. Do not attempt authenticated reporting functions.
queries_used: Uprava RS za javna plačila UJP javna naročila razpisi ujp.gov.si

candidates.source_name: UJP — Uprava Republike Slovenije za javna plačila (institution hub)
candidates.why_relevant: The public sector's payment infrastructure operator (UJPnet, UJP eRačun e-invoicing, UJPlačam cashless payment points). It is both a large payments buyer and the operator of rails that private payment vendors interconnect with — its tenders and service announcements reveal the public-sector payments technology roadmap.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the gov.si UJP page news/documents plus storitve.ujp.gov.si and eracuni.ujp.gov.si service notices; cross-reference UJP as 'naročnik' on enarocanje.si.
queries_used: Ministrstvo za finance javna naročila plačilni promet FURS eDavki razpis
Uprava RS za javna plačila UJP javna naročila razpisi ujp.gov.si

candidates.source_name: Erar (KPK) — public sector transaction transparency application
candidates.why_relevant: Anti-corruption commission application exposing transaction-level payments by public institutions, state-owned enterprises and municipalities — goods and services, consultancy/intellectual services, and (since Sept 2024) e-invoices of budget users and transfers abroad. Lets you quantify what any named payments/IT vendor is actually paid by public financial bodies, month by month.
candidates.access_status: public web application; bulk/API access to verify
candidates.legal_status: official transparency tool (ZIntPK); reuse subject to portal terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by recipient (vendor) tax number and by payer (SID banka, FURS, UJP, ministries); check the OPSI Erar dataset entry for a bulk/structured export before scraping. Note KPK's own warning that some UJP-sourced data contained errors at relaunch — validate outliers.
queries_used: Erar KPK transakcije javnega sektorja podatki plačila proračun erar.si

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — odločitve v postopkih pravnega varstva
candidates.why_relevant: Review-body decisions on challenged tenders expose the technical requirements, evaluation criteria, competing bidders and pricing disputes in far more detail than the award notice — e.g. a decision involving Banka Slovenije over IT equipment covering technical specs, delivery, training and installation. Also flags which vendors fight for which public financial accounts.
candidates.access_status: public searchable database; also mirrored as an OPSI dataset
candidates.legal_status: public decisions of a state body
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OPSI 'zbirka izdanih odločitev DRK' dataset for bulk; use dkom.si search for recent items and the 'zadeve v odločanju' page for pending disputes as an early signal.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila informacijska oprema banke

candidates.source_name: MJU Direktorat za javno naročanje — letna statistična poročila o oddanih javnih naročilih
candidates.why_relevant: Annual statistical report (statutory under ZJN-3/ZJNPOV) giving procurement share of GDP, procedure types, subject categories, e-procurement uptake, financing sources and supplier location/size. Provides the denominator and multi-year trend against which individual banking/payments awards can be sized.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull of the newest PDF from the DJN pages plus the OPSI dataset entry; extract the tables once per year.
queries_used: statistika javnih naročil ministrstvo za javno upravo odprti podatki podatki.gov.si javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — katalog informacij javnega značaja & publikacije
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority; its FOI catalogue states that all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si, which pins the route for tracking central-bank IT, cash-handling and payment-system purchases. The publications and release-calendar pages also anchor payment-systems reporting (Žiro kliring, TARGET/STEP2 participation).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a pointer: monitor bsi.si publications and release-date calendar; run 'Banka Slovenije' as naročnik on enarocanje.si/TED for its tenders.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna naročila objave javna naročila bsi.si

candidates.source_name: Računsko sodišče RS — revizijska poročila (Court of Audit)
candidates.why_relevant: Performance and compliance audits of state bodies frequently dissect exactly the IT/payments projects in scope — e.g. the audit of the DURS information-system renewal and consolidation of tax payment sub-accounts, and audits of customs IT for excise procedures. Audits give budgets, delays, vendor management failures and named contracts that never appear in the award notice alone.
candidates.access_status: public PDF archive, sl and partial en
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the audit archive filtered by auditee (FURS/DURS, CURS, Ministrstvo za finance, UJP, SID banka) and by keywords 'informacijski sistem', 'plačil'; archive PDFs.
queries_used: Računsko sodišče revizijsko poročilo banka informacijski sistem plačila rs-rs.si

candidates.source_name: FURS / Ministrstvo za finance — Finančna uprava RS (institutional & procurement footprint)
candidates.why_relevant: FURS is a very large public buyer of payment-collection, e-invoicing, fiscal-verification (davčno potrjevanje računov) and card-acceptance services, and its detailed descriptions of tax payment mechanics document the public payment rails (payments into UJP-managed sub-accounts at Banka Slovenije). Both a tender source and a domain-terminology source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track gov.si FURS news and 'podrobnejši opisi' documents; separately query 'Finančna uprava Republike Slovenije' as naročnik on enarocanje.si and TED.
queries_used: Ministrstvo za finance javna naročila plačilni promet FURS eDavki razpis

candidates.source_name: OPSI publisher page — Ministrstvo za finance / UJP datasets
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the machine-readable datasets published by the Ministry of Finance/UJP — the fastest way to discover structured public-payment and budget-user data (e-invoices, sub-accounts, payment flows) instead of guessing at endpoints.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CKAN organization listing API; snapshot the dataset inventory quarterly and diff for new releases.

candidates.legal_status: commercial site — ToS likely restrict scraping

negative_findings.description: Searched for a dedicated public-procurement section on Banka Slovenije's own site (bsi.si) in Slovenian.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone 'javna naročila' section surfaced on bsi.si; the FOI catalogue indicates all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si instead. Only a numismatic products invitation was found on bsi.si itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the collector must treat enarocanje.si/TED as the single route for central-bank tenders rather than expecting an issuer-side feed.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both sl and en for concrete Slovenian contract-award notices for banking/payment-system services or payment terminals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-engine results returned only portal-level and legal/explanatory pages, no individual banking or payments award notice. Notice-level detail appears to live behind the portals' own search forms, which general web search does not index well.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signals that keyword web search is inadequate for this cell — collection must go through the portals' native search/API (enarocanje.si forms, e-JN listing, TED Search API with CPV filters), not through search engines.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a public, bulk-exportable interface to UJP JN Plačila (statutory monthly reporting of executed public-procurement payments since 1 Jan 2023).
negative_findings.result_summary: Two entry points found (jnplacila.ujp.gov.si and jnplacila.si) but whether a public search/export exists for third parties, versus authority-only login, was not established in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is potentially the single richest quantitative feed in the cell; its access mode must be resolved before the collection design is fixed. Not recorded as unavailable — only as unverified.

negative_findings.description: KPK press release regarding data quality in the relaunched Erar application.
negative_findings.result_summary: KPK publicly stated it had not been informed of incorrect data in the UJP database before the new Erar went live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Erar figures for public-sector payments should be treated as indicative and cross-checked against UJP JN Plačila or the underlying contract before any number is quoted as fact.

negative_findings.description: Checked whether state-owned commercial banking stakes give a separate procurement route.
negative_findings.result_summary: SDH reports on state capital investments in aggregate; individual portfolio banks are private-law entities whose procurement is generally not on the public portal unless they qualify as contracting authorities. No portal-side evidence found either way in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the collector from assuming state-linked commercial banks will appear as naročniki on enarocanje.si; their signal must come from the private-bank cell instead, with SDH as the ownership bridge.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed programmatic search/API path for enarocanje.si notices; only individual form-id URLs and a general terms PDF were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect the portal's own search form and the Uradni list PJN2 subdomain for query parameters or an export; read the Splošni pogoji PDF for scraping constraints before building a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV code set for banking, payment services, payment terminals and financial-sector IT was not enumerated in this pass, yet all portal/TED filtering depends on it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit CPV allowlist (66100000 banking and investment services, 66500000 insurance/pension, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30144200/30162000/48xxxxxx equipment and software) and validate it against a sample of known Slovenian award notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Some state-linked financial actors in scope were not individually researched: Kapitalska družba (KAD/Modra zavarovalnica), Zavarovalnica Triglav's state-linked ownership, Slovenski regionalno razvojni sklad, Javni štipendijski sklad, and municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate finance-sector contracting authorities from the e-uprava institution directory and AJPES, then run each as a naročnik query against enarocanje.si, TED and Erar.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature — award notices, DKOM decisions, Court of Audit reports and SDH/SID reports are predominantly Slovenian, with only partial English versions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Slovenian-language extraction and translation in the pipeline; use TED's bilingual notices as the main English-side cross-reference.

coverage_gaps.description: No backfill route confirmed for pre-2018 Slovenian award notices (e-JN open dataset starts April 2018).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate TED bulk XML archives and the OpenTender/OCDS publication for pre-2018 Slovenian coverage; document the earliest reliable date per source.

brief: Slovenia's public-procurement route to banking and payments intelligence is unusually well-structured: a statutory national notice portal (enarocanje.si, run by Uradni list), the transactional e-JN system with an OPSI open-data mirror of live tenders, and EU-level duplication on TED for above-threshold notices — together naming buyers, winning vendors, values and dates. Two transparency layers make it exceptional: UJP JN Plačila, where since 2023 every contracting authority must report the payments actually executed under procurement contracts, and KPK's Erar, which exposes transaction-level public-sector spend down to individual suppliers (with a documented data-quality caveat). Depth beyond the notices comes from DKOM review decisions, which expose technical specifications and competing bidders, and from Court of Audit reports on payment and tax IT systems; the state-owned side is covered by SID banka's annual reports and press releases and by SDH's reports to the National Assembly on state capital investments, which also bridge into privately-held banks. The main open risks are access mechanics — no confirmed API for enarocanje.si and an unverified public export for JN Plačila — and the absence of a validated CPV taxonomy, without which sector filtering will be unreliable.
